stories.hook: ¿Psilocibina puede aliviar la depresión en trastornos de personalidad?
stories.headline: Psilocibina reduce síntomas depresivos y suicidios en pacientes con PD de tipo B
stories.finding: En un subgrupo de diez pacientes con depresión resistente y trastorno de personalidad de tipo B, la terapia asistida con psilocibina redujo la puntuación MADRS de 30,4 a 22,5 el día 1, manteniéndose alrededor de 22–25 en los meses subsiguientes. La ideación suicida también disminuyó significativamente.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la psilocibina, combinada con psicoterapia, puede ser una opción segura y eficaz para pacientes con depresión resistente y trastornos de personalidad, un grupo que suele responder mal a los tratamientos convencionales.
stories.paperTitle: Exploratory safety, tolerability, and feasibility of psilocybin-assisted psychotherapy for adults with co-occurring treatment-resistant depression and cluster B personality disorders
stories.originalAbstract: Cluster B personality disorders (PDs) are highly comorbid with depression and are associated with attenuated antidepressant response. No clinical trials to date have reported on psilocybin-assisted psychotherapy (PAP) in comorbid treatment-resistant depression (TRD) and PDs. This is the first clinical trial to describe a subgroup of ten participants with a comorbid PD ( n = 9 cluster B; n = 1 cluster C) and TRD who underwent PAP, representing a secondary analysis of a larger trial. The trial was registered on clinicaltrials.gov under the identifier NCT05029466 (Registration Date: 2021-08-26). Three participants dropped out of the trial. Mean MADRS scores decreased from 30.4 pre-treatment to 22.5 at day 1, 24.9 at week 2, and 22.3 at month 6. Mean MADRS Suicidal ideation (SI) item declined from 3.2 to 1.6 at day 1, 2.3 at week 2, and 1.2 at month 6. There was substantial heterogeneity in outcomes amongst participants. No serious adverse events were recorded. This is the first clinical trial evidence that PAP may reduce depression and SI in comorbid cluster B PDs, suggesting further trials may be warranted.

stories.hook: ¿Qué desencadena la rumiación en momentos críticos?
stories.headline: Métodos de inducción de rumiación no generan efectos significativos
stories.finding: En un experimento con 86 participantes, tres técnicas de inducción de rumiación (memoria autobiográfica triste con tarea de manipulación de respuesta, película triste con memoria autobiográfica y tarea, y melodía triste con memoria) no produjeron diferencias estadísticamente significativas respecto a los controles. Sin embargo, entrevistas con ocho sujetos revelaron que la presencia de un recuerdo triste personal, un estado de ánimo bajo y alta sensibilidad emocional facilitan la rumiación, mientras que la ausencia de recuerdo, la revaluación positiva y la baja intensidad del estímulo la inhiben.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la inducción experimental de rumiación es difícil de lograr y que los factores personales y emocionales son clave, lo que orienta a clínicos a focalizar intervenciones en la reestructuración de recuerdos y en la regulación emocional.
stories.paperTitle: Hetkeseisundi rumineerimise esilekutsumise meetodite ja mõjude võrdlus
stories.originalAbstract: Study piloted effects of different state rumination induction methods and qualitatively studied what factors facilitate or inhibit rumination induction. Three methods were used: sad autobiographical memory with Response Manipulation Task (RMT); sad film with autobiographical memory and RMT; sad melody with sad autobiographical memory and RMT. Control groups had same conditions without rumination and negative valence components. 86 people completed online experiment, and 8 participated in interviews. Results were statistically not significant. Based on the interviews, factors inducing rumination were: presence of personally significant sad memory; prior low mood; and self-reported emotional sensitivity. Inhibiting factors included: absence of significant memory; positive reappraisal during task; perceived low intensity of stimuli. Results of study contribute to understanding rumination mechanisms and to improvement of experimental paradigms.

stories.hook: ¿Los ritmos circadianos del HRV revelan ansiedad en docentes?
stories.headline: Docentes con trastorno de pánico pierden la variación diurna-nocturna del HRV
stories.finding: Se comparó la HRV diurna y nocturna en 17 docentes con trastorno de pánico, 21 con trastorno de ansiedad generalizada y 40 docentes sanos. Los pacientes con pánico perdieron la amplitud día‑noche de los parámetros parasimpáticos, evidenciando alteraciones circadianas más graves que en el grupo de GAD y controles.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la HRV circadiana puede servir como biomarcador objetivo para identificar docentes con trastorno de pánico y guiar intervenciones dirigidas a regular la actividad autonómica, mejorando la prevención de complicaciones somáticas.
stories.paperTitle: The circadian rhythm of heart rate variability in academic teachers with anxiety disorders
stories.journal: International Journal of Occupational Medicine and Environmental Health
stories.originalAbstract: OBJECTIVES: The academic teachers are increasingly diagnosed with anxiety disorders, which results from a high level of work-related stress. These disorders can be both an independent risk factor of many somatic conditions and the cause of complications of various organic disorders leading to poor prognosis. The purpose of this study is to compare the heart rate variability (HRV) recorded both during the day and at night in the academic teachers with anxiety disorders and healthy individuals. MATERIAL AND METHODS: (PSE-10) questionnaire. Seventeen examined patients were diagnosed with panic disorder (PD) and 21 with generalized anxiety disorder (GAD). The control group consisted of 40 healthy academic teachers. The resulting 3 groups were compared in terms of circadian HRV using the Oxford Medilog Suprima Holter System. RESULTS: The HRV analysis showed the nocturnal falls in the time and frequency parameters related to the parasympathetic activity, e.g., high frequency. The most unfavorable alterations were observed in the PD group, which comprised the disappearance of day vs. night amplitude of the majority of HRV parameters. Hence, the PD group was particularly susceptible to the arrhythmic events. It was noticeable that nocturnal vagotonia in the PD group was significantly lower as compared with the GAD and control group. CONCLUSIONS: The innovative aspect of the present study was to find a distinct profile of HRV with regard to the types of anxiety disorders because of the existing considerable differences between the nature of PD and GAD. Int J Occup Med Environ Health. 2026;39(1):55-67.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la TCC reducir la ansiedad más que la medicación?
stories.headline: La TCC disminuye la ansiedad un 78,2% en 12 semanas
stories.finding: En un ensayo aleatorizado con 370 adultos (18‑65 años), la TCC (n=127) redujo la ansiedad un 78,2 % a las 12 semanas, superando a farmacoterapia (n=124) y a lista de espera (n=119). Los beneficios se mantuvieron a los 3 y 6 meses, confirmando la superioridad sostenida de la TCC.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo respalda la TCC como primera línea para trastornos de ansiedad, ofreciendo una mejora clínica sustancial y duradera, lo que puede guiar decisiones terapéuticas y políticas de salud hacia intervenciones psicológicas más efectivas y coste‑eficientes.
stories.paperTitle: The role of cognitive behavioral therapy in treating anxiety disorders: A review of recent advances
stories.originalAbstract: Historically, anxiety disorders have ranked among the most widespread mental health conditions worldwide, affecting roughly one in four adults during their lifetime and imposing an enormous burden on healthcare systems across Europe and beyond. Cognitive behavioral therapy, commonly referred to as CBT, has gained a solid reputation as a front-line psychological treatment for these conditions over several decades. This research set out to evaluate recent advances in CBT protocols for treating generalized anxiety disorder, social anxiety disorder, and panic disorder among adults presenting at two French academic medical centers. We enrolled 370 participants aged 18 to 65 years between June 2020 and August 2022, assigning them to one of three arms: a manualized CBT program (n=127), pharmacotherapy alone with selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (n=124), or a waitlist control condition (n=119). Primary outcomes were measured using the Generalized Anxiety Disorder 7-item scale and the Beck Anxiety Inventory at baseline, weeks 4, 8, and 12, and at 3-month and 6-month follow-ups. Results showed that the CBT group achieved a mean anxiety symptom reduction of 78.2% by week 12, compared with 62.4% in the pharmacotherapy arm and just 30.2% in the waitlist control. Effect sizes for CBT were large, with Cohen's d values ranging from 0.72 for behavioral activation components to 0.93 for exposure-based elements. Participants with panic disorder showed the most rapid initial response, while those with generalized anxiety disorder demonstrated the most stable long-term gains. Dropout rates stayed low at 11.8% for CBT versus 18.7% for pharmacotherapy. These findings confirm that structured CBT interventions remain highly effective and may outperform medication-only approaches for several anxiety subtypes, especially when treatment incorporates exposure therapy and cognitive restructuring as core components.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué el alexitimia vincula trauma infantil y disociación?
stories.headline: Alexitimia como posible mediador entre experiencias adversas infantiles y disociación
stories.finding: Una revisión sistemática de ocho estudios mostró que siete evaluaron alexitimia y todos hallaron asociaciones positivas significativas con la disociación en adultos con experiencias adversas infantiles. Esto indica que la dificultad para identificar emociones podría mediar la relación entre trauma temprano y síntomas disociativos.
stories.takeaway: Comprender el papel de la alexitimia ayuda a diseñar intervenciones focalizadas en la regulación emocional, ofreciendo una vía para prevenir o reducir la disociación en personas con historia de trauma infantil.
stories.paperTitle: The role of alexithymia in the association between adverse childhood experiences and dissociation: a systematic review
stories.originalAbstract: Background Adverse childhood experiences (ACEs) are consistently associated with dissociation in adulthood, yet the psychological mechanisms underlying this relationship remain insufficiently understood. Alexithymia has been proposed as a potential explanatory mechanism because of its role in emotional processing and affect regulation. However, findings across empirical studies remain heterogeneous. Objective This systematic review aimed to examine the role of alexithymia in the association between ACEs and dissociation in adulthood, with particular attention to its potential mediating function. Methods: A systematic search was conducted in PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science following PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Studies were eligible if they included adults with a history of ACEs, assessed dissociation and alexithymia, and examined their interrelationships. Studies assessing interoceptive processes within the same broader framework were also retained as supplementary exploratory evidence. Eight empirical studies met the eligibility criteria. Results Seven studies directly assessed alexithymia, all of which reported significant positive associations with dissociation among adults with histories of childhood adversity. Three studies reported mediation effects, whereas two did not support mediation and two provided correlational or predictive evidence without formal mediation. One additional study assessed body awareness and reported improvements alongside reductions in dissociative symptoms following a body-oriented intervention. Conclusions Current evidence indicates that alexithymia is consistently associated with dissociation following childhood adversity and may represent a relevant explanatory pathway between ACEs and dissociative outcomes in some populations. Nevertheless, methodological heterogeneity and the predominance of cross-sectional designs preclude firm causal conclusions. Future longitudinal studies are needed to clarify these pathways, while the possible contribution of interoceptive processes remains an exploratory question for future research.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo perciben los terapeutas psicodinámicos el cambio terapéutico?
stories.headline: Los psicoterapeutas psicodinámicos identifican nueve dimensiones del cambio
stories.finding: En un estudio fenomenológico con ocho psicoterapeutas psicodinámicos (cuatro mujeres y cuatro hombres), se realizaron entrevistas semiestructuradas y un análisis de contenido consensual. El proceso reveló nueve temas estructurales, entre los que destacan la orientación, motivaciones, espacio relacional, herramientas de cambio y la subjetividad del terapeuta.
stories.takeaway: Comprender estas dimensiones ayuda a guiar la formación, supervisión y práctica clínica, favoreciendo intervenciones más alineadas con la experiencia del terapeuta y potenciando la efectividad del proceso terapéutico.
stories.paperTitle: Psychodynamic psychotherapists’ perceptions of change: A phenomenological analysis
stories.originalAbstract: Objective: This qualitative study aimed to investigate how experienced psychodynamic psychotherapists conceptualize change in psychotherapy by engaging in guided reflection on their professional experiences. Method: Eight psychodynamic therapists participated in the study, with four females and four males. Semi-structured interviews were conducted within a phenomenological-hermeneutic research framework, focusing on several key themes related to the change in psychotherapy. Then, phenomenological categories were identified through a consensual content analysis, applying an inductive approach. Results: Through an iterative analysis, nine overarching themes and their respective subcategories emerged: (a) Orientation; (b) Motivations For Choosing to Train in the Psychodynamic Approach; (c) Areas of Intervention; (d) The Relational Space as the Foundation of Therapy and the Process of Change; (e) Focusing, Exploring, and Processing the Patient's Internal States; (f) The Tools of Change in the Psychodynamic Approach; (g) The Subjectivity and Experiences of the Therapist; (h) New Conceptions of Change in the Psychodynamic Approach; (i) Change as an Unpredictable Process Difficult to Model. Discussion: The findings underscore the importance of employing qualitative methods to study psychotherapy change, as its complexity cannot be easily reduced to simplified models.

stories.hook: ¿Es la anorexia un trastorno de regulación emocional?
stories.headline: Revisión sistemática confirma la relevancia de la regulación emocional en la anorexia
stories.finding: El análisis de 134 artículos elegibles, extraídos de 562 estudios, mostró que la mayoría de la evidencia respalda la pertinencia de la regulación emocional en la anorexia nerviosa. Se observaron vulnerabilidades emocionales individuales y ambientales, uso de estrategias de regulación adaptativas y desadaptativas, y comportamientos alimentarios como forma de regular emociones.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo refuerza la necesidad de integrar intervenciones centradas en la regulación emocional dentro del tratamiento de la anorexia, mejorando la comprensión y la eficacia clínica.
stories.paperTitle: Does evidence support an emotion regulation model of anorexia nervosa? A systematic review of over a decade of research.
stories.originalAbstract: Objectives: Over a decade ago, a model was proposed to explain the role of emotion regulation in the development and maintenance of anorexia nervosa (AN). Research on emotion regulation in AN has since rapidly increased, prompting a need to revisit the evidence base regarding whether AN may be considered a disorder of emotion regulation. Methods: We conducted a systematic review using Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines across PubMed, PsychInfo, and Web of Science on the emotion regulation literature in the years following the proposal of this emotion regulation model. Inclusion criteria were: (a) empirical and quantitative articles in English; (b) human samples; (c) analysis pertaining to AN; and (d) focused on a domain of emotion regulation. The review yielded 134 eligible articles (from a pool of 562 non-duplicate studies) examining emotion regulation constructs in AN, encompassing individual-level emotional and environmental vulnerabilities, use of adaptive and maladaptive emotion regulation strategies, and eating disorder behaviors as emotion regulation. Results: Overall, evidence supported the relevance of emotion regulation to the conceptualization of AN. Individuals with AN demonstrated greater individual and environmental vulnerabilities to dysregulation, less adaptive and more maladaptive emotion regulation strategies, and greater tendency to engage in eating disorder behaviors to regulate emotions. Findings on emotional reactivity were more mixed. Discussion: Results highlight that continued research on emotion regulation across restrictive eating presentations is needed. Further, treatments directly targeting emotion regulation warrant further investigation. Emotion regulation models continue to hold promise in characterizing core mechanisms of AN.

stories.hook: ¿Qué factores mentales empeoran el sueño en hipertensos mayores?
stories.headline: Ansiedad, depresión y soledad predicen pobre calidad del sueño en ancianos hipertensos
stories.finding: En una muestra de 414 pacientes hipertensos mayores de 60 años, el 86.5 % presentó mala calidad del sueño (PSQI > 5). Los análisis de regresión logística mostraron que la ansiedad, la depresión y la soledad estaban asociadas significativamente con la probabilidad de presentar alteraciones del sueño.
stories.takeaway: Identificar ansiedad, depresión y soledad como factores de riesgo permite intervenir tempranamente en pacientes hipertensos mayores, mejorando su sueño y reduciendo complicaciones cardiovasculares asociadas.
stories.paperTitle: Anxiety, depression, and loneliness as key predictors of sleep disturbances in hypertensive elderly
stories.journal: Annali di Igiene Medicina Preventiva e di Comunità
stories.originalAbstract: Background: Poor sleep quality is common and is associated with chronic diseases, mental health problems, and reduced quality of life. However, limited evidence exists regarding sleep quality and its potential risk factors among elderly patients with hypertension. Objective: To assess demographic and health-related factors associated with sleep disturbances in elderly patients with hypertension. Methods: A cross-sectional survey was conducted among 414 hypertensive patients aged ≥60 years who received treatment at the Geriatrics Department, Can Tho Central General Hospital, from March 2020 to February 2022. Sleep quality was measured using the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), with poor sleep quality defined as a global PSQI score >5. Additional data were collected on demographic and mental health factors. Logistic regression models were applied to identify factors associated with sleep quality using odds ratios (ORs), and ROC curve analyses were performed to evaluate predictive factors for sleep disturbances in this population. Results: Among 414 elderly hypertensive patients, the mean PSQI score was 9.72, with 86.5% classified as having poor sleep quality. Older age (≥75 years) significantly increased the risk of sleep disturbance (OR = 1.9, p = 0.037). Depression (OR = 7–11, p < 0.001), anxiety (OR = 7.7, p < 0.001), and loneliness (p < 0.001) were strongly associated with poor sleep quality, while low quality of life markedly increased the risk (OR = 4.7, p < 0.001). ROC analysis showed that the Hamilton Anxiety Scale (AUC = 0.797) and GDS-30 (AUC = 0.748) had the best predictive value, followed by loneliness (AUC = 0.711). Conclusions: Poor sleep quality is highly prevalent among elderly patients with hypertension. Psychological factors, particularly anxiety, depression, and loneliness, are stronger predictors than demographic or clinical variables, highlighting the need for mental health screening and integrated interventions to improve sleep quality in this population.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la atención plena transformar la flexibilidad psicológica en dolor crónico?
stories.headline: Intervenciones basadas en mindfulness mejoran la flexibilidad psicológica en pacientes con dolor crónico
stories.finding: Un meta‑análisis de 60 ensayos controlados aleatorizados (N=6692) mostró que las intervenciones de aceptación y mindfulness aumentaron la flexibilidad psicológica en post‑tratamiento y a corto y largo plazo (g = 0.35‑0.69). La aceptación también mejoró (g = 0.41‑0.77), mientras que la acción comprometida y los valores no mostraron efectos significativos.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo respalda la incorporación de programas basados en mindfulness y aceptación en el manejo del dolor crónico, pues mejoran la flexibilidad psicológica, un predictor clave de adaptación y reducción del sufrimiento, aunque se necesita mayor calidad metodológica.
stories.paperTitle: Do Acceptance‐ and Mindfulness‐Based Interventions Improve Psychological Flexibility in People With Chronic Pain? A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
stories.originalAbstract: BACKGROUND: Acceptance- and mindfulness-based interventions are effective for improving pain-related outcomes, yet their effects on psychological flexibility have not been meta-analyzed. This systematic review and meta-analysis addressed this gap by comparing these interventions with control conditions on psychological flexibility and its core dimensions in adults with chronic pain. METHODS: Searches were conducted in PsycINFO, MEDLINE, Cochrane CENTRAL, Scopus and Web of Science from inception to May 2025. Sixty randomized controlled trials comprising 6692 participants were included. Meta-analyses were conducted for global psychological flexibility (k = 17), acceptance (k = 38), committed action (k = 4) and values (k = 4). Heterogeneity, risk of bias and certainty of evidence were assessed. RESULTS: Interventions significantly improved psychological flexibility at post-treatment, short-term (≤ 6 months) and long-term (> 6 months) follow-up (g = 0.35-0.69), and acceptance across all time points (g = 0.41-0.77). Effects for committed action and values were non-significant. Heterogeneity was substantial, most trials had a high risk of bias, and the certainty of evidence was low to very low. Moderator analyses indicated larger effects when interventions were compared with inactive controls, delivered by psychologists or implemented as stand-alone programs. CONCLUSIONS: Evidence suggests that acceptance- and mindfulness-based interventions may improve global psychological flexibility and acceptance. However, the certainty of evidence was low to very low, and most included trials were at high risk of bias. More rigorous trials are needed to clarify effects across specific dimensions of psychological flexibility. SIGNIFICANCE STATEMENT: This systematic review and meta-analysis provide the first comprehensive synthesis of the effects of acceptance- and mindfulness-based interventions on psychological flexibility in chronic pain. These findings show that these interventions improve psychological flexibility, particularly pain acceptance, supporting it as a clinically relevant treatment target. TRIAL REGISTRATION: PROSPERO: CRD420251018441.
stories.abstract: BACKGROUND: Acceptance- and mindfulness-based interventions are effective for improving pain-related outcomes, yet their effects on psychological flexibility have not been meta-analyzed. stories.hook: ¿Cómo las microagresiones erosionan la autoestima de las consejeras afroamericanas?
stories.headline: Microagresiones laborales provocan burnout y disminuyen la autoestima en consejeras afroamericanas
stories.finding: El estudio cualitativo reveló que las microagresiones crónicas y normalizadas en el entorno laboral generan estrés, dudas sobre sí mismas y agotamiento emocional en consejeras afroamericanas. Se identificaron seis temas, entre ellos la devaluación profesional, la falta de protección y la supresión emocional como estrategias de supervivencia.
stories.takeaway: Comprender este proceso permite diseñar intervenciones institucionales y de supervisión que mitiguen las microagresiones, preserven la autoestima y reduzcan el burnout, mejorando la salud mental de las profesionales y la calidad del servicio de consejería.
stories.paperTitle: African American Women Counselors’ Lived Experiences of Burnout Due to Microaggressions
stories.originalAbstract: Within the counseling profession, African American women navigate unique challenges in the workplace, often experiencing microaggressions that contribute to stress, self-doubt, and emotional exhaustion. While systemic racial issues drive workplace microaggressions, counselor educators and supervisors remain ill-equipped to support African American women through the resulting burnout. The purpose of this qualitative study was to explore the lived experiences of African American women counselors to understand how microaggressions can lead to burnout and affect their psychological well-being. Guided by a transcendental-phenomenological qualitative framework, semi-structured interviews were conducted to capture participants’ experiences, exploring the lived experiences of African American women counselors who experience burnout due to microaggressions in their professional roles. The interview data were analyzed using Moustakas’s (1994) transcendental phenomenological method. Six themes emerged: (a) Workplace microaggressions: Chronic and normalized; (b) Professional devaluation and conditional belonging; (c) Silence and lack of protection; (d) Survival: Emotional suppression and psychological disconnection; (e) Burnout: Cumulative & Cognitively Draining; (f) Self-Preservation: Coping and Exit. The findings from this study can be used to create positive social change by highlighting challenges related to microaggressions and burnout, informing institutional and workplace policies, advocating for culturally responsive support, and promoting interventions to improve counselors' overall well-being.

stories.hook: ¿Los check‑ins reducen el estigma y la ansiedad en policías?
stories.headline: Check‑ins estructurados reducen el auto‑estigma y síntomas de ansiedad, depresión y PTSD en policías.
stories.finding: Los oficiales que participaron en al menos una sesión de check‑in mostraron puntuaciones significativamente más bajas en auto‑estigma, ansiedad, PTSD y depresión que los que no participaron. La diferencia más marcada se observó en el auto‑estigma.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la implementación de check‑ins regulares puede ser una estrategia efectiva para reducir el auto‑estigma y los síntomas psicológicos en policías, facilitando la búsqueda de ayuda y mejorando la salud mental laboral.
stories.paperTitle: The Effect of Mental Health Check-Ins on Stigma and Symptoms of Anxiety, Depression, and Post-Traumatic Stress
stories.originalAbstract: This applied quantitative study examined whether participation in structured mental health check-ins was associated with self-stigma toward seeking psychological help and reported symptoms of anxiety, post-traumatic stress, and depression among law enforcement officers. Using a cross-sectional, nonexperimental comparative design, anonymous survey data were collected from 130 active sworn officers across 10 small and mid-sized Iowa law enforcement agencies. The agencies included those with and without mandatory check-in policies; primary comparisons were based on officers’ reported participation in at least one check-in. Measures included the Self-Stigma of Seeking Help Scale, Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7, PTSD Checklist for DSM-5, and Patient Health Questionnaire-9. Descriptive statistics, reliability analyses, independent-samples t-tests, analysis of variance, multiple linear regression, and chi-square tests were used. Officers who participated in check-ins reported significantly lower self-stigma, anxiety, post-traumatic stress, and depression scores than nonparticipants, with the strongest group difference observed for stigma. Participation remained a significant predictor after controlling for rank and years of experience. Frequency analyses showed significant differences for stigma, anxiety, and post-traumatic stress, but not depression, without a uniform dose-response pattern. Categorical screening classifications did not differ significantly by participation status. Because participation was not randomly assigned and data were collected at one point in time, the findings demonstrate associations rather than causation. The results support structured check-ins as a promising leadership strategy for normalizing mental health engagement. Future longitudinal and multi-state research should examine change over time and compare program design, confidentiality, and provider characteristics.

stories.hook: ¿Qué habilidades sociales impulsan relaciones románticas saludables?
stories.headline: Empatía y revaluación cognitiva favorecen la satisfacción romántica en jóvenes
stories.finding: Una revisión sistemática de 26 estudios mostró que la preocupación empática y la revaluación cognitiva se asocian consistentemente con mayor satisfacción en la relación y una resolución constructiva de conflictos. En contraste, la angustia personal y la supresión expresiva se relacionan con resultados negativos.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo orienta a terapeutas a fortalecer la empatía y la revaluación cognitiva en intervenciones con parejas jóvenes, mientras que reduce la angustia personal y la supresión emocional, mejorando la calidad relacional y el bienestar psicológico.
stories.paperTitle: The role of socio-cognitive abilities in adolescent and young adult romantic relationships: a systematic review
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract High-quality romantic relationships are linked to better psychological well-being, yet adolescents and young adults vary in the quality of their romantic experiences. Socio-cognitive abilities, including empathy, emotion regulation, and theory of mind, may play a role in shaping romantic outcomes. This systematic review synthesizes evidence from 26 studies to examine how these abilities relate to romantic relationship quality in adolescents and young adults, following PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Given the limited research on theory of mind in this population, perspective-taking was additionally included as a closely related socio-cognitive process. Findings indicate that the relational value of these abilities depends substantially on which subcomponent is engaged: empathic concern and cognitive reappraisal were consistently associated with higher relationship satisfaction and more constructive conflict resolution, while personal distress and expressive suppression showed the opposite pattern. Perspective-taking also showed consistent positive associations. Research on theory of mind in romantic contexts remains scarce, but available evidence suggests a promising role in partner well-being and emotion regulation. The review further identifies an asymmetry between actor and partner effects and addresses developmental and gender-related patterns. Overall, the review highlights the possible interdependence of socio-cognitive abilities in adolescent and young adult romantic relationships and the limited evidence available on theory of mind.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo potenciar la prosocialidad en la escuela?
stories.headline: Integrar mente, emoción y moral potencia la prosocialidad infantil
stories.finding: El estudio integró evidencia longitudinal y meta‑analítica que indica que la teoría de la mente, la conciencia emocional y el razonamiento moral, combinados, predicen la empatía, la cooperación y la sensibilidad moral en niños. Además, se propone que fortalecer esas tres habilidades mejora el clima prosocial escolar.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo orienta intervenciones educativas que simultáneamente desarrollan ToM, conciencia emocional y razonamiento moral, ofreciendo una estrategia basada en evidencia para fomentar conductas prosociales y reducir conflictos en contextos escolares.
stories.paperTitle: Theory of Mind, Emotion Awareness, and Moral Reasoning: An Integrative Framework for Understanding Children’s Prosocial Development in Educational Contexts
stories.journal: Journal of Education and Educational Research
stories.originalAbstract: Prosocial behavior is one of the most important topics in contemporary research. Researchers examined the relationships between prosocial behavior and Theory of Mind (ToM), emotion awareness and moral reasoning separately; however, there are few studies that explore how these three factors influence prosocial behavior integrated together. This paper focuses on how these three factors influence prosocial behavior in school. Based on scoping reviews, longitudinal studies and meta-analytic evidence, the study shows that ToM helps children to analyze and interpret others’ behavior; Emotion awareness develops empathy and regulation; Moral reasoning guides fairness judgment. These three processes together predict children’s empathy, cooperation, and moral sensitivity. Subsequently, this paper extends these models into educational context and proposes the strategies for these three aspects in classroom activities, teacher training and peer-based interventions. The study shows that enhancing the ability in these three areas can improve the prosocial climates in schools. Overall, this paper concludes that integrating cognitive, emotional, and moral education is important for promoting empathy, fairness, and social responsibility in children.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo influye la visión del futuro en el peso corporal?
stories.headline: Perspectiva temporal futura protege contra mayor índice de masa corporal
stories.finding: Los estudiantes con mayor orientación al futuro presentan un BMI más bajo (β = -0.23), mientras que la orientación hedonista presente se asocia a un BMI más alto (β = 0.18). Además, el autocontrol y el consumo de bebidas azucaradas median estas relaciones, sugiriendo rutas de intervención.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo indica que fortalecer el autocontrol y reducir el consumo de bebidas azucaradas puede contrarrestar los efectos de una perspectiva hedonista, ofreciendo una vía para diseñar programas de prevención de obesidad basados en la gestión del tiempo psicológico.
stories.paperTitle: Time Perspective and BMI: The Mediating Roles of Self-Control and Sugar-Sweetened Beverage Consumption
stories.originalAbstract: Objective: This study aims to investigate the associations between future, present-hedonistic, and present-fatalistic time perspectives (TP) and body mass index (BMI) among college students, and to examine whether self-control and sugar-sweetened beverage (SSB) consumption mediate these relationships. Methods: A cross-sectional survey was conducted in Jiangsu Province, China, involving 920 college students. The survey collected data on participants' height, weight, future TP, present-hedonistic TP, present-fatalistic TP, self-control, and SSB consumption. Multiple hierarchical regression analysis was employed to identify potential covariates, and three chain mediation models were analyzed using the PROCESS macro (Model 6) in SPSS version 26. Results: The results indicated that future TP was negatively associated with BMI (β = -0.23, 95% CI = [-3.81, -2.24]), and present-hedonistic TP showed a positive association (β = 0.18, 95% CI = [1.47, 2.73]). Present-fatalistic TP was not significantly related to BMI. Furthermore, self-control and SSB consumption mediated the relationships between future TP, present-hedonistic TP, present-fatalistic TP, and BMI (β = -0.02, 95% CI [-0.04, -0.01]; β = 0.02, 95% CI [0.01, 0.02]); β = 0.02, 95% CI = [0.01, 0.02]). Conclusion: TP, self-control, and SSB consumption are important factors associated with BMI among college students. Promoting a future-oriented TP and self-control, while reducing present-oriented TP and SSB intake, may support more effective BMI management. These findings offer theoretical implications for designing targeted health interventions.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo afecta la enfermedad crónica al duelo tras un terremoto?
stories.headline: El 23,8% de sobrevivientes con enfermedad crónica desarrolló duelo prolongado tras el terremoto
stories.finding: En una muestra de 143 adultos con enfermedad crónica tras el terremoto de 2023, el 23,8 % cumplió criterios de trastorno de duelo prolongado (PGD). La muerte traumática de un familiar de primer grado aumentó la prevalencia (p < 0.001) y la mitad de los jubilados (6 de 12) presentaron PGD.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo alerta a los profesionales de salud sobre la alta frecuencia de duelo prolongado en pacientes crónicos tras desastres, subrayando la necesidad de detección temprana y de intervenciones específicas, especialmente en sobrevivientes de muerte traumática y jubilados.
stories.paperTitle: Exploring the bereavement experiences and prevalence of prolonged grief disorder among 2023 Turkish earthquake survivors with advanced chronic disease: a mixed methods study
stories.originalAbstract: OBJECTIVE: While traumatic experience of a loved one's death and having a chronic disease are both risk factors for prolonged grief disorder, there are no published studies on bereavement among earthquake survivors with advanced chronic disease. The objective of this study is to explore the bereavement experiences and prevalence of prolonged grief disorder (PGD) among 2023 Türkiye earthquake survivors with advanced chronic diseases. DESIGN/SETTING: A mixed methods design of cross-sectional survey using the Prolonged Grief Scale (PG-13) and semi-structured interviews was used to provide a detailed understanding of the grief phenomenon in the context of bereaved adults with advanced chronic disease after the earthquake in Türkiye. PARTICIPANTS: 143 participants completed the survey, and interviews were conducted with 12 bereaved survivors with advanced chronic disease. RESULTS: Our results indicated a prevalence of PGD among bereaved adults of 23.8%. The traumatic death of first-degree relatives was associated with a higher PGD prevalence (p<0.001). PGD developed in 50% of retirees (n=6). Six themes were identified: (1) bereavement reactions, (2) coping style, (3) disrupted grieving, (4) impact of grief on chronic disease, (5) moving forward and (6) unmet needs. CONCLUSIONS: We recommend a person-centred bereavement care that prioritises early identification and reduction of prolonged grief risk factors. We propose a framework for bereaved survivors to use in the development of an effective bereavement service model. This model may be used by mental health professionals and policymakers to respond sensitively to the values, needs and preferences of bereaved survivors who have experienced the unnatural death of a loved one.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el mini‑baloncesto mejorar la función ejecutiva en TDAH?
stories.headline: Intervención de mini‑baloncesto de 12 semanas potencia la función ejecutiva en niños con TDAH
stories.finding: En un ensayo controlado aleatorizado con 35 niños (6‑11 años) diagnosticados con TDAH, 18 fueron asignados al programa de mini‑baloncesto y 17 al grupo control. El grupo de ejercicio mostró mejoras significativamente mayores en control inhibitorio (F=15.15, p<0.001, η²=0.35) y memoria de trabajo (F=30.55, p<0.001, η²=0.52) frente al control.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que una actividad física lúdica y estructurada, como el mini‑baloncesto, puede ser una intervención no farmacológica eficaz para potenciar la función ejecutiva en niños con TDAH, facilitando su rendimiento académico y adaptación social.
stories.paperTitle: Effects of a 12-week mini-basketball exercise intervention on executive function in children with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder: a randomized controlled trial
stories.originalAbstract: Background Executive function (EF) deficits are a core cognitive impairment in children with ADHD. While physical exercise has been shown to benefit EF, the effects of cognitively engaging, sport-based interventions remain insufficiently understood. This study examined the effects of a 12-week mini-basketball intervention on EF in children with ADHD using a randomized controlled trial design. Methods Thirty-five children aged 6–11 years meeting DSM-5 criteria for ADHD were randomly assigned to an exercise group (EG, n = 18) or a control group (CG, n = 17). The EG participated in a 12-week moderate-intensity mini-basketball program (3 sessions/week, 45 min/session), whereas the CG maintained usual activities. Inhibitory control (IC), working memory (WM), and global EF were assessed at baseline and post-intervention using the Childhood Executive Functioning Inventory (CHEXI). Between-group differences were analyzed using ANCOVA controlling for baseline values. Results Compared with the CG, the EG demonstrated significantly greater improvements in IC ( F = 15.15, p < 0.001, partial η 2 = 0.35), WM ( F = 30.55, p < 0.001, partial η 2 = 0.52), and global EF ( F = 40.68, p < 0.001, partial η 2 = 0.59), all indicating large effect sizes. Within-group analyses showed significant improvements across all EF domains in the EG (all p < 0.05), with no significant changes observed in the CG. Conclusion A 12-week mini-basketball intervention significantly enhanced multiple domains of EF in children with ADHD. These findings highlight the potential of cognitively engaging, sport-based exercise as an effective and feasible non-pharmacological strategy for improving executive function in this population. However, the relatively small sample size and reliance on parent-reported measures should be considered when interpreting the results.

stories.headline: La percepción del estudiante predice habilidades socioemocionales más que la de padres o docentes
stories.finding: En una muestra de 7,246 estudiantes, las asociaciones entre la percepción de la relación con el docente y cinco dominios de habilidades socioemocionales fueron positivas y mayores (pendientes 0.234‑0.256) que cuando los resultados los informaron padres (0.083‑0.109) o docentes (0.080‑0.106). Todas las asociaciones permanecieron significativas tras corrección por falsos descubrimientos.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la percepción del alumno sobre su relación con el docente es un indicador más sensible de sus competencias socioemocionales, lo que implica que las escuelas deberían priorizar la evaluación directa del estudiante al diseñar intervenciones de apoyo.
stories.paperTitle: Reporting-source differences in associations between student-perceived relationships with teachers and social–emotional skills: evidence from the Suzhou SSES 2019 sample
stories.originalAbstract: Introduction Students’ perceptions of their relationships with teachers may be associated with social-emotional functioning, but the magnitude of this association may depend on who reports the outcomes. This study examined whether student-perceived relationships with teachers were associated with five domains of social-emotional skills reported by students, parents, and teachers, and whether association magnitudes differed across reporting sources. Methods Data were drawn from 7,246 students in 151 school-by-cohort units in the Suzhou sample of the 2019 OECD Survey on Social and Emotional Skills. Survey-weighted fixed-effects models estimated within-unit associations, matched stacked models compared slopes across informants, and school-by-cohort-grouped cross-validation assessed incremental prediction. Results All 15 informant-by-domain associations were positive and remained significant after false-discovery-rate correction. In matched samples, student-report slopes ranged from 0.234 to 0.256, compared with 0.083 to 0.109 for parent reports and 0.080 to 0.106 for teacher reports. All student-versus-adult contrasts remained significant after correction, whereas none of the parent-versus-teacher contrasts did. The same pattern was observed in 44 of 45 skill-level tests. Adding the relationship index improved out-of-fold weighted R² in all 30 prediction comparisons, although absolute predictive performance was weak, particularly for adult-reported outcomes. Discussion Student-perceived relationships with teachers showed cross-informant relevance, while the strongest observed associations occurred when both the relationship measure and the social-emotional outcome shared the student reporter. These findings suggest that reporting source should be treated as substantive information in educational assessment and that relationship ratings should be used to contextualize, rather than replace, multi-informant evidence.
stories.abstract: Introduction Students’ perceptions of their relationships with teachers may be associated with social-emotional functioning, but the magnitude of this association may depend on who reports the outcomes. This study examined whether student-perceived relationships with teachers were associated with five domains of social-emotional skills reported by students, parents, and teachers, and whether association magnitudes differed across reporting sources. Methods Data were drawn from 7,246 students in 151 school-by-cohort units in the Suzhou sample of the 2019 OECD Survey on Social and Emotional Skills. Survey-weighted fixed-effects models estimated within-unit associations, matched stacked models compared slopes across informants, and school-by-cohort-grouped cross-validation assessed incremental prediction. Results All 15 informant-by-domain associations were positive and remained significant after false-discovery-rate correction. In matched samples, student-report slopes ranged from 0.234 to 0.256, compared with 0.083 to 0.109 for parent reports and 0.080 to 0.106 for teacher reports. All student-versus-adult contrasts remained significant after correction, whereas none of the parent-versus-teacher contrasts did. The same pattern was observed in 44 of 45 skill-level tests. Adding the relationship index improved out-of-fold weighted R² in all 30 prediction comparisons, although absolute predictive performance was weak, particularly for adult-reported outcomes. Discussion Student-perceived relationships with teachers showed cross-informant relevance, while the strongest observed associations occurred when both the relationship measure and the social-emotional outcome shared the student reporter. These findings suggest that reporting source should be treated as substantive information in educational assessment and that relationship ratings should be used to contextualize, rather than replace, multi-informant evidence.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el ginseng revertir la depresión mediante mitofagia?
stories.headline: Kai‑Xin‑San restaura sinapsis hippocampal y alivia depresión en ratones
stories.finding: En ratones bajo estrés crónico impredecible, Kai‑Xin‑San revirtió dosis‑dependientemente los comportamientos depresivos y restauró densidad de espinas, número de sinapsis y proteínas sinápticas en el hipocampo. La mejora dependió de la activación de la mitofagia vía PINK1/Parkin, bloqueada por ciclosporina A.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que potenciar la mitofagia con fórmulas a base de ginseng podría ser una estrategia novedosa para tratar la depresión resistente, al restaurar la plasticidad sináptica hippocampal.
stories.paperTitle: Ginseng-containing Kai-Xin-San alleviates depressive-like behaviors in CUMS-exposed mice by restoring hippocampal synaptic deficits through mitophagy activation
stories.originalAbstract: ABSTRACT Background Hippocampal synaptic deficits constitute a core pathology of depression. Mitophagy, an essential mitochondrial quality-control process, is crucial for synaptic homeostasis. The classical antidepressant formula Kai-Xin-San (KXS) has established clinical efficacy, yet whether it rescues synaptic deficits by modulating mitophagy remains unknown. Methods We employed a chronic unpredictable mild stress (CUMS) mouse model. The effects of KXS were comprehensively evaluated through behavioral tests combined with morphological, ultrastructural, and molecular analyses of hippocampal synapses and mitochondria, complemented by mitophagy inhibition. Results KXS administration dose-dependently reversed CUMS-induced depressive-like behaviors and restored hippocampal synaptic deficits, including neuronal architecture, spine density, synapse number, and key synaptic protein levels. Mechanistically, KXS attenuated mitochondrial damage and coordinately activated mitophagy via multiple pathways, involving both the PTEN-induced putative kinase 1 (PINK1)/Parkin axis and receptor-mediated routes, thereby enhancing autophagic flux. Crucially, the mitophagy inhibitor Cyclosporin A (CsA) abolished all KXS-induced benefits on mitophagy, synaptic repair, and behavior. Conclusion This study demonstrates that KXS restores hippocampal synaptic deficits and exerts antidepressant-like effects through multi-pathway activation of mitophagy, which is essential for clearing damaged mitochondria. Our findings not only elucidate a novel mitophagy-dependent neuroprotective mechanism for KXS but also provide a mechanistic rationale for its clinical application and advance the therapeutic strategy of targeting the mitochondria-synapse axis in depression.
